name: aizign-workspace
description: npm workspace root for Aizign TypeScript packages and harness adapters (not published)

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run pack:check
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aizign/protocol && npm run build -w @aizign/adapter-testkit && npm run build -w @aizign/adapter-dsh
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:spec && npm run test:experiments && npm run test:benchmarks
